_doc: The live gates tree_round.py install combines with the fuzz gate (combine_gates.py). Each was run on the clean tree of `tree_commit` (docs/HISTORY.md, 'Live gate on the four dumps', 8b0b614: the r14 tree, 1184f75). A live verdict counts for a function only while that function's text in the tree is identical to its text at tree_commit; otherwise it is left out and the function stands on its other gates.
